:::{#exm-constructive-proof}
#### A constructive proof

Claim: there are [integers](number-systems.qmd#def-integers) $m$ and $n$
with $m + n = 1$.

Proof: take $m = 0$ and $n = 1$.
Then $m + n = 0 + 1 = 1$.

This [proof](#def-proof) is a [constructive proof](#def-constructive-proof),
since it names an [integer](number-systems.qmd#def-integers) for each of the two [existential quantifiers](#def-existential-quantifier).

:::
